ja: • 2016年３月26日開業の北海道新幹線（新青森～新函館北斗）用に開発・製造されたJR北海道の新幹線用車両。
• JR東日本のE5系をもとに開発。外装は彩香パープルの帯とシンボルマークを、内装の一部は独自のものに変更。
• 全10両のフル編成はAセット×２セット、Bセット×４セットで再現できる。
• 先頭車（１号車：H523-0）＋パンタ付き中間車（３号車：H525-0）＋パンタなし中間車（５号車：H525-400）の３両セット。
• パンタ付き中間車（７号車：H525-100）の屋根付き。３号車と７号車の作り分けが可能。
• NEW SGフレーム、ステッカー付属。
en: • A JR Hokkaido Shinkansen vehicle developed and manufactured for the Hokkaido Shinkansen (Shin-Aomori-Shin-Hakodate-Hokuto), which opened in March 2016.
• Developed based on JR East's E5 series. The exterior has a Ayaka purple belt and symbol mark, and some of the interior has been changed to unique ones.
• A full formation of all 10 cars can be reproduced with A set x 2 sets and B set x 4 sets.
• 3-car set: Lead car (No. 1: H523-0) + Intermediate car with pantograph (No. 3: H525-0) + Intermediate car without pantograph (No. 5: H525-400).
• Intermediate car with pantograph (car No. 7: H525-100) with roof. It is possible to make car No. 3 and car No. 7 separately.
• NEW SG frame and sticker included.
